instruction: I'd like to enable the background cone feature in VLC. This gives a nice visual effect when no media is playing.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

Expected value is semantically correct: qt-bgcone=1 enables the background cone feature as required by the instruction

Coverage is complete: Evaluator verifies the single requirement (qt-bgcone=1) specified in the instruction
Edge cases handled: Metric handles missing setting (defaults to '1'), type conversion, and file errors
